Code-review spawns 4 mandatory parallel agents â senior-engineer, software-architect, qa, regression-tester â all receiving diff + browzer deps (forward + reverse) + browzer mentions; the regression-tester runs the canonical pre-push gate at PACKAGE granularity, enumerates failures per-test, and reproduces each against `main` via git stash for accurate `preExistingOnMain` flagging.
